name: Hyakugojuunenme no Mahoutsukai
original_name: 百五十年目の魔法使い
source:
This is the debut title for Mikeou’s doujin circle, PINK CHUCHU. The 150 year old northern capital of Lilac City is home to over 1.9 million people. Katsura returned to this city with his mother Midori after many years and reunited with the three Hoshioki sisters: the dependable Rira, the cool Nadeshiko, and the doting Marika. He transferred into their school, Lilybell Gakuen, then his father explained that their family are magicians who protect Lilac City. However, he must choose one of the Hoshioki girls to serve as an ‘intermediary’ who bestows magic upon him.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/05/17/may-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是同人社团PINK CHUCHU的Mikeou出道作。拥有150年历史的北方首都紫丁香城居住着超过190万人。桂与母亲绿时隔多年回到这座城市，与星置三姐妹重逢：可靠的莉拉、冷静的抚子，以及溺爱他的玛丽卡。他转入三姐妹就读的百合铃学园，随后父亲告诉他，他们一家是守护紫丁香城的魔法师。不过，他必须从星置家的女孩中选择一人，作为向他赐予魔法的“中介者”。

[译自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2015/05/17/may-2015-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
